references.text: XAVIER : «Are you the cab I ordered?»
XAVIER : «Super. I’m the one you’re waiting for. Be right there. »
XAVIER : «You can start driving. Neuilly, please.»
XAVIER : «Who?»
XAVIER : «Oh, him! He’s fine. Don’t worry. He was unconscious long before he went out the window.»
XAVIER : «And an ambulance is on its way.»
XAVIER : «So. No worries.»
XAVIER : «Pretty good, yeah.»
XAVIER : «I screwed up a little… but all in all, it was a good evening.»
XAVIER : «You?»
XAVIER : «Ok, all right. Come on, let’s talk about the elephant in the room. You’re on to me and you know it. I’m the Masked Joker.»
XAVIER : «The Masked Joker… The hero that makes Parisian nights more… peaceful? No?»
XAVIER : «I’m all over Twitter. So, probably on the radio and in the newspapers, I think.»
XAVIER : «Oh, don’t worry about it. It’s normal. I’m only just starting out.»
XAVIER : «It’s hard to manage everything at once: the marketing campaign, physical training, managing the equipment, the sponsors, plus…»
XAVIER : «Plus the actual fights, you know?»
XAVIER : «I protect people. I’m a guardian.»
XAVIER : «No, I don’t have any superpowers.»
XAVIER : «Yes… I mean, for the moment, I mostly take care of small time crooks, pickpockets…»
XAVIER : «It’s not very prestigious but you have to start somewhere.»
XAVIER : «So, how about the name… you like it?»
XAVIER : «Yes. The Masked Joker. I think it sounds good.»
XAVIER : «It’s Joker. Like the card. And Masked because I’m wearing a mask.»
XAVIER : «Oh cool! Finally, someone gets what I’m trying to do!»
XAVIER : «I can’t tell you how hard it is to find a decent name!»
XAVIER : «Awful?»
XAVIER : «Ah, ok. You’re not the only one, actually.»
XAVIER : «See, I wanted something that wasn’t too…»
XAVIER : «Problematic.»
XAVIER : «I did a lot of brainstorming and came up with the Masked Joker.»
XAVIER : «I haven’t gotten great feedback but it’s hard these days to find a name everyone likes.»
XAVIER : «You have to make sacrifices if you want your core business to succeed.»
XAVIER : «That’s what they tell us at school, anyway.»
XAVIER : «Yes, and ENK…»
XAVIER : «Shit. I almost gave you the name of my business school.»
XAVIER : «What an idiot. Can you imagine if Bruce Wayne went around telling everyone he was Bruce Wayne?»
XAVIER : «No. Batman! If BATMAN went around telling everyone he was BRUCE WAYNE.»
XAVIER : «I’m getting all mixed up.»
XAVIER : «I think I… I’m hurt.»
XAVIER : «No, no, I’m fine… I shouldn’t have… jumped out of the window like that.»
XAVIER : «But you were already coming down the street and I didn’t want to make you wait.»
XAVIER : «Ok, I broke something. I’m sure of it. Oh fuck, that hurts!»
XAVIER : «Pull over… right there in front of the driveway…»
XAVIER : «Don’t worry. It’s… it’s just a flesh wound. I’ll be home in two minutes and I have everything I need to… take care of myself.»
XAVIER : «One last thing… Please don’t say anything about ENKID… I’m trying to lead a double life and it’s not super easy.»
XAVIER : «ENKID. My business school…»
XAVIER : «Oh! I just got it. You’re playing along. Ok. Great.»
XAVIER : «Perfect. I hope to…»
XAVIER : …see you again… sometime…»
XAVIER : «I’ll be much better soon. No worries.»
XAVIER : «You’re really a classy guy.»
XAVIER : «We can go. Same address as last time.»
XAVIER : «I’ll tell you in a minute. First, start driving.»
XAVIER : «The police are on their way and I don’t want to run into them.»
XAVIER : «And I don’t want to get you mixed up in all this.»
XAVIER : «I…»
XAVIER : «Yeah, yeah… I’m ok.»
XAVIER : «I’m sorry, but…»
XAVIER : «I think I shit my pants a little.»
XAVIER : «But don’t you worry… there are no marks.»
XAVIER : «I was just so scared.»
XAVIER : «When he pulled his katana out… Man… I was like “That’s it. It’s over. You had a good life and now he’s going to cut you up like a turkey.”»
XAVIER : «But actually, I handled it.»
XAVIER : «Yeah, I handled it. I handled the hell out of it.»
XAVIER : «Of course!»
XAVIER : «Ok… all right… last time I was not at my best. But I’m getting better. I’m making progress.»
XAVIER : «And now, I’m on to something big.»
XAVIER : «It’s a kind of Japanese saber, you see?»
XAVIER : «I didn’t think he’d have that kind of weapon. Those guys aren’t Japanese at all, actually.»
XAVIER : «Actually, since last time, I’ve made a whole lot of progress.»
XAVIER : «I’m investigating a sort of… organization… like, mob types, you know?»
XAVIER : «They’re forcing kids to work in this squat. They’re sorting through jewelry, wallets. Sometimes they’re sent out to panhandle.»
XAVIER : «Girls are sent to… I mean, you get the gist, right?»
XAVIER : «But the police aren’t doing anything about it.»
XAVIER : «No idea.»
XAVIER : «You think?»
XAVIER : «I don’t know. I think there’s something else to it.»
XAVIER : «First off, the kids aren’t French.»
XAVIER : «The organization is tied to the Albanians and this not-so-nice German guy. They have ties with an extreme right-wing organization with connections to two police captains.»
XAVIER : «I came to get photos. I want to alert the press.»
XAVIER : «And while I was going about my business… that guy jumped me with his katana.»
XAVIER : «Scared me to death.»
XAVIER : «Crazy… I don’t know.»
XAVIER : «Yeah, it’s dangerous… but that’s not what’s most important.»
XAVIER : «I’m ok. I swear.»
XAVIER : «What I’m about to say will probably sound pretty weird, ok?»
XAVIER : «Since I’ve been chasing this organization down, I really feel like I’m doing something useful.»
XAVIER : «Like I can really make a difference.»
XAVIER : «And shit… that makes it all worth it.»
XAVIER : «Would it… would it be ok if I just got some shut-eye for the rest of the trip?»
XAVIER : «I… I think I need to…»
XAVIER : «Already?»
XAVIER : «I could have slept for about 20 more hours.»
XAVIER : «I have an essay to turn in six hours from now. Wish me luck.»
XAVIER : «Thank you!»
XAVIER : «I don’t really have the choice. I’m not planning on making a career out of…»
XAVIER : «This.»
XAVIER : «Unless I get into merchandising: mugs, t-shirts…»
XAVIER : «Then, maybe…»
XAVIER : «When you’re in business school, it’s actually pretty stupid to be a good student.»
XAVIER : «I mean, once you get in and you’ve paid… it’s a done deal. Good or bad, your grades don’t make any difference.»
XAVIER : «Anyway. Shower, breakfast, essay, sleep. That’s the plan.»
XAVIER : «Drive. Now.»
XAVIER : «Go. Fast.»
XAVIER : «Faster. As fast as possible.»
XAVIER : «It’s a bomb.»
XAVIER : «Yes, a bomb. The kind that explodes and kills people.»
XAVIER : «I’m telling you, it’s a bomb.»
XAVIER : «On the contrary.»
XAVIER : «Tonight, you and I are going to save lives.»
XAVIER : «Would you mind just…»
XAVIER : «Thank you.»
XAVIER : «I need a moment to think.»
XAVIER : «You… you happen to know where I can get rid of this thing?»
XAVIER : «No.»
XAVIER : «Well, yeah, I had a plan: ask you to come pick me up and ask you if you knew where I could get rid of this thing!»
XAVIER : «A bit.»
XAVIER : «I wasn’t gonna leave it there!»
XAVIER : «It’s a bomb. They have to be disposed of. Otherwise, well, I mean, bombs kill, you know?»
XAVIER : «Especially since… it’s going to… explode in just… a few minutes.»
XAVIER : «I’d rather not say.»
XAVIER : «In five minutes.»
XAVIER : «Or rather… in five minutes… one minute ago…»
XAVIER : «But the good news is that I just had an idea: the Seine.»
XAVIER : «If I throw the bomb in the Seine, it won’t hurt anyone.»
XAVIER : «How long until we get there?»
XAVIER : «Ok. I knew you were the right man for the job.»
XAVIER : «Listen… I’ve got to be honest with you…»
XAVIER : «I wouldn’t normally run the light.»
XAVIER : «But in this case… come on.»
XAVIER : «That was… daring.»
XAVIER : «I wanted to thank you.»
XAVIER : «You’ve been an incredible partner to have.»
XAVIER : «I think I’ll close my eyes.»
XAVIER : «You… You believe in fate?»
XAVIER : «That makes this situation all the more incredible.»
XAVIER : «You don’t know if you’re going to die right now… and yet…»
XAVIER : «You’re helping me.»
XAVIER : «Well, then I’m having even more trouble understanding why you’re here.»
XAVIER : «According to you, this is all just a crap shoot.»
XAVIER : «You impress me.»
XAVIER : «And that’s why you’re doing this? Why you’re risking your life?!»
XAVIER : «I didn’t believe in fate before tonight. I only had faith in work, motivation, results…»
XAVIER : «But now that I’ve crossed your path…»
XAVIER : «I have no more doubts.»
XAVIER : «We… almost died back there?»
XAVIER : «To be honest…»
XAVIER : «I’m trying to say things that sound deep so I won’t sound too stupid if they’re my last words.»
XAVIER : «Shit.»
XAVIER : «Sorry, but… shit, shit, shit.»
XAVIER : «Holy fuck. Thank God!»
XAVIER : «You… know where you’re going?»
XAVIER : «Whatever happens…»
XAVIER : «I want to say…»
XAVIER : «I think that after tonight…»
XAVIER : «I’m done with all this.»
XAVIER : «I’m going to stop now.»
XAVIER : «We had… one second to go.»
XAVIER : «You saved our lives.»
XAVIER : «Oh yes, it is… Listen, I’ve got to run. It’s a bit complicated to explain why, but let’s just say…»
XAVIER : «This might seem weird but… the police are corrupted to the core.»
XAVIER : «It’s hard to tell with you… I never know whether you’re being sarcastic or not. Here.»
XAVIER : «Good luck.»
